subject: POC Data & Prompt Log Collection — Finlytics POC (RDW-2381)
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Lina Park <lina.park@finlytics.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-10T15:04:00-07:00
Subject: POC Data & Prompt Log Collection — Finlytics POC (RDW-2381)

Hi Lina — great to meet today, thanks for the time. Quick recap and proposed next steps for the POC data handoff so we can get the trial started: 

Summary of what we heard from your team:
- Goal: reduce false-positive alerts in your analyst triage assistant by 20% while maintaining sub-250ms median token latency for assistant responses.
- Required evaluation: precision@top1, recall on labeled subset, and latency/cost per 1k requests.
- Data: you have ~120k historical analyst prompts and anonymized assistant transcripts to share (will need redaction).

Proposed success criteria (we can refine):
1) Precision@1 improves by >=20% on the 5k labeled test set supplied by Finlytics.
2) No more than 10% regression in latency at target throughput (200 rps).
3) End-to-end integration demo with two analyst workflows within 6 weeks.

Immediate asks from us to enable the eval pipeline:
- Please upload a redacted sample of 10k prompt+response pairs (CSV) and the labeling schema.
- Confirm the target test set (we expect a 5k labeled subset).
- Sign the minimal data processing addendum (we can attach a DPA template if you need it).

Attached: prompt_template_v2.csv (simple columns for id, prompt_text, assistant_reply, label, context_tags) and redaction_guidelines.pdf.

Suggested timeline:
- By 2026-09-14: Finlytics uploads redacted sample + confirms labeled test set owner.
- 2026-09-15 to 2026-09-22: Redwood builds ingest + eval harness (Jordan) and sets up transfer (Marissa).
- 2026-09-23: Internal review and first-run results; schedule demo the following week.

Ownership:
- Sean: commercial lead, overall POC coordination and legal touchpoints.
- Marissa: data transfer & infra (S3 bucket + permissions).
- Jordan: eval harness and prompt/eval metric definitions.

Lina — can you confirm the upload timeline and who will own the labeled test set on your side? If helpful I can create a short kickoff agenda and book a 30-min transfer call next week.

Thanks,
Sean
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0133

Attachments: prompt_template_v2.csv, redaction_guidelines.pdf

Subject: Re: POC Data & Prompt Log Collection — Finlytics POC (RDW-2381)

Thanks Sean — appreciated the succinct recap. Confirming: we can deliver a redacted 10k sample by 2026-09-14 and the labeled 5k test set owner will be Carlos Ruiz (cc'd). Quick answers inline: 

- Success criteria: OK to start with your three bullets; we will add an internal business metric (ops deflection delta) as a secondary metric.
- Redaction: we'll follow your attached guidelines. We will also supply a CSV of tags (severity, workflow).
- DPA: procurement@finlytics.io will review; cc'd for timeline.

Carlos, can you own the upload and point us to the person who will do the redaction? We plan to use an internal redaction tool and will deliver both the redacted CSV and raw logs under NDA if needed.

Link to our internal POC brief: https://finlytics.atlassian.net/l/cp/ABC12345 (internal)

Lina
Lina Park
Head of Product, Finlytics
lina.park@finlytics.io

Subject: Re: POC Data & Prompt Log Collection — Finlytics POC (RDW-2381)

Thanks for the confirmation, Lina. Operational notes and task assignments from our side: 

Plan to receive files:
- We will provision a dedicated S3 prefix in the Redwood ingestion bucket and provide a presigned upload link to Carlos. See attached s3_transfer_instructions.md for required file layout (CSV, UTF-8, comma).

Task owners (Redwood):
- Marissa: create S3 prefix, generate presigned links, validate sample schema upon upload (due 2026-09-15).
- Jordan: stand up eval harness (metric definitions: precision@k, recall, latency percentiles), will ask for a small sample run within 48 hours of upload.
- Sean: track legal/comms and confirm DPA/contract addendum if procurement requires it.

We will also run an automated redaction check against your guidelines and report any fields that still contain PII so Carlos can resubmit. Please confirm the preferred upload format (single CSV vs. chunked files). Our recommendation is single CSV for the 10k sample and chunked (<=50k rows) for larger transfers.

Attachments: s3_transfer_instructions.md

Marissa
